reason: Verification failed with critical logic errors (incidence double counting), intermittent policy enforcement due to buffer reliance, and a major performance hotspot in retail allocation. Several spec mismatches remain (network_type, missing behaviors/metrics). There is clear potential for substantial improvement within remaining iterations, and we are not yet at the maximum.

specific_areas: Fix incidence double counting by deduplicating newly exposed susceptibles per day; align counterfactual incidence on the same deduplicated target set.
Stabilize policy enforcement: run PolicyModule daily or use persistent state fallback in PolicyEnforcement when buffers are absent; ensure correct module order.
Vectorize RetailMarket allocation with a single multinomial draw and apply ration limits; remove per-unit loop.
Apply adoption_bias and a small compliance_propensity term in AdoptionDecision.
Implement RiskUpdateModule using prevalence_feedback_weight and optional decay.
Respect disease_module_enabled by conditionally including Movement/Interaction and DiseaseDynamics modules.
Implement network_type='scale_free' (Barabasi-Albert) and 'erdos_renyi'; keep ring-lattice as fallback.
Add metric aliases and compute policy_impact_effect_size (simple DiD over pre/post windows for adoption and compliance).
Improve compliance metric to reflect actual mask wearing under mandates (not policy_pressure proxy).
Add spec-aligned Person attribute aliases (health_risk_level, access_to_masks, current_mask_status, disease_status) and home/work IDs; placeholders for movement and risk/trust updates.
Add unit tests for transmission deduplication, policy persistence fallback, and vectorized retail allocation; include a simple performance benchmark.

task_understanding.adjustments: Enforce strict alignment with the provided specification: required attributes/behaviors, parameter usage (disease_module_enabled, network_type), and metrics naming. Maintain a mapping layer (aliases) where internal names differ.

data_analysis.adjustments: Plan and compute policy_impact_effect_size via pre/post (7-day) windows; ensure counterfactual incidence uses deduplicated targets for comparability. Track and log prevalence for risk updates.

model_planning.adjustments: Rework module schedule and dependencies: PolicyModule tick daily or ensure persistence; insert RiskUpdate after DiseaseDynamics; conditionally include disease modules; define clear fallbacks when buffers are absent.

code_generation.adjustments: Produce patch-style changes: dedup incidence and counterfactual; vectorize retail allocation with multinomial; implement Barabasi-Albert and ER generators; add Person aliases and metric aliases; apply adoption_bias and compliance term; compute policy_impact_effect_size.

code_verification.adjustments: Add unit tests for transmission deduplication, policy enforcement persistence, and retail allocation capping; include a microbenchmark to confirm retail performance improvements; check that disease_module_enabled disables relevant modules.

simulation_execution.adjustments: Run smoke tests with disease on/off; test multiple network types; run with N≈1k to validate performance; ensure deterministic RNG seeds and log key events (policy changes).

result_evaluation.adjustments: Report both legacy and spec-aligned metric keys; validate policy_impact_effect_size and compliance under mandates; confirm steady-state and time-to-threshold metrics compute correctly.

feedback_generation.adjustments: Provide concise, prioritized fix list with code snippets; flag which changes address critical issues and performance; note any behavior changes introduced by fixes.
